support_boundary: IR ownership covers metadata that consumes emitted descriptors, registration tables, module manifests, packaging records, and runtime snapshot serialization as provenance; artifacts do not create positive runtime behavior
selectors: README:hand-authored .ll files or placeholder object artifacts do not count as proof
retired_surface_rule: hand-authored IR, placeholder objects, generated reports, sidecar-only evidence, registration replay packets, and snapshot-only claims are provenance-only until behavior owners claim support
